conflict_flags.rationale: Three-way disagreement between client presentation (144 units, tower only) vs. BFA R1 scope (154+, including townhomes) vs. BFA v0 scope (170+, including townhomes). The client presentation explicitly notes 'TOWER ONLY' and separately states 8 townhomes have their own hot water boilers, which may partially explain the difference. The R1 and v0 scopes likely count units served by the shared DHW loop differently, and the version evolution (170+ → 154+) may reflect a field count correction. Cannot resolve from available documents; field set to missing. Human review recommended.
